retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast stage performance photograph featuring a vocal group in formal wear with dominant, tightly-kerned swash serif typography in the upper quadrant.
triggerTerms: swash serif display type on dark photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric scene of three male performers in black tuxedos under warm stage spotlights, anchored by a large, decorative yellow serif title that utilizes dramatic swashes and tight line spacing.
coreVisualRelationships: Large yellow display type overlapping a dark, textured background
Three figures arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on faces and shirts
Small metadata text positioned in the extreme corners
coreInvariants: Dark, nearly black background with subtle grain or texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three performers occupy the lower half of the frame at a medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow title in the upper left quadrant serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright yellow title down to the illuminated faces of the performers, then across the horizontal line of the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the upper right and between performers provides breathing room for the heavy type.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark shadows (background and suits)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the saturated yellow type and white highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, yellow, white, and warm skin tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif with decorative swashes
letterConstructionRules: Dramatic ball terminals and teardrop swashes
Thick vertical strokes with hairline horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'T', 'F', and 'I' feature extended decorative swashes
Lowercase 's' and 'n' have rounded, fluid terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the decorative display serif with a small, clean sans-serif for technical metadata.
graphicDevices: Small boxed logo in upper right

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1960s/70s decorative serif aesthetic with similar ball terminals.
Provides the high-contrast stroke and dramatic capital swashes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of three men in black tuxedos performing on a dark stage with spotlights hitting their faces and white shirts. The top third should be mostly dark negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold yellow swash-serif text in the upper left, tightly kerned. Add small white sans-serif technical text in the top left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the typography yellow and high-contrast?
Are the performers in formal wear?
Is the background predominantly dark and textured?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital clarity; maintain a vintage film aesthetic
Ensure text does not obscure the performers' faces
postGenerationChecks: Check for tight character spacing in the title
Verify high contrast between white shirts and black suits
Ensure the yellow text is the brightest element in the top half
Confirm the presence of film-like grain
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast stage photography + Bold Swash Serif Title + Dark Negative Space = Vintage Soul Aesthetic
